::: {.lead-bio}
I'm an Assistant Professor of Psychology at California State University, Fresno.
I study personality and hierarchy at multiple levels of analysis.
:::

## Research interests

::: {.interests}
Social Cognition &middot; Emotion &middot; Personality &middot; Status Hierarchy &middot; Evolution
